question: We need to finalize the budget ______ we present the proposal to the board next week.
explanation: before 后面接具体时间，指“在呈报之前”完成预算。

question: The shipment arrives ______ the customs clearance is completed.
explanation: once 用于“一……就……”，表示“清完关后”。

question: The contract terms have been revised ______ the client’s feedback.
explanation: in response to 表示“针对……的回应”，符合“针对客户反馈修改”。

question: ______ the revised forecast, the board approved the investment plan.
explanation: Given 表示“鉴于”，表示原因或依据，符合“鉴于预测调整，董事会批准”。

question: The new employee orientation will be held ______ the merger is complete.
explanation: once 用于“一……就……”，表示“合并完成后”。

question: Our sales team exceeded the target ______ aggressive promotional activities.
explanation: due to 后接名词短语，表示“由于”，因果关系。

question: The project manager assigned additional resources ____ there were delays in the supply chain.
explanation: because 表示原因，指出因供应链延迟故分配额外资源。

question: ______ the conference call scheduled for tomorrow, all participants should review the agenda.
explanation: prior to 后接名词，表示“在……之前”，用于正式场合。

question: The company will announce the restructuring plan ____ the shareholder meeting next month.
explanation: at 表示精确时间点，指“在下月股东大会上”。

question: We have reduced operational costs by 15% ____ improved efficiency.
explanation: through 表示“通过”，表示手段，符合“通过提高效率削减成本”。

question: The deadline for submitting applications will be extended ____ technical difficulties.
explanation: due to 后接名词短语，表示原因，因技术问题延期。

question: The client requested a revision _____ the contract terms were unclear.
explanation: given 表示“鉴于”，表示客观陈述原因，符合正式商务语境。

question: ______ the successful launch of the product, we recommend expanding distribution.
explanation: in light of 表示“鉴于”，表示基于成功情况的建议。

question: The accounting department will reconcile all transactions ____ the end of each quarter.
explanation: at 表示固定时间点，指“在每个季度结束时”。

question: The vendor delivered the materials ____ they were promised.
explanation: when 用于表示时间，指“他们承诺的那时”。

question: The HR director will interview candidates ____ they submit their applications.
explanation: upon 用于“在……之时”，表示申请提交后马上面试。

question: We must complete the audit ____ we can release the quarterly financial statements.
explanation: once 表示“一……就……”，审计完成就可发布报告。

question: The marketing budget will increase ____ user demand grows.
explanation: as 表“随……而”，表示随需求增长而增加。

question: _____ the office renovation, normal operations will continue uninterrupted.
explanation: in spite of 表示“尽管”，表示备考，指即使装修也正常运营。

question: The shipment will arrive from overseas _____ customs clearance is processed.
explanation: once 用于“一……就……”，清关后到货。

question: The new policy applies _____ employees in the North America division.
explanation: apply to 表示“适用于”，指政策适用于北美部门员工。

question: _____ the revised project timeline, the client has approved the budget.
explanation: based on 表示“基于”，符合“根据新时间表批准预算”。

question: The training program will be conducted ____ three different topics.
explanation: across 表示“穿越、横跨”，指教学覆盖三个主题。

question: The CFO will present the financial report ____ the board meeting.
explanation: during 用于表示在某事件期间发生，指在会议期间报告。

question: The invoice will be issued ____ payment is received.
explanation: once 用于“一……就……”，收到款后开票。

question: Company policy prohibits employees ____ personal calls during work hours.
explanation: prohibit + from + V-ing 是固定搭配，禁止个人打电话。

question: We anticipate a 20% growth ____ mobile device sales.
explanation: growth in 表示“增长”，指销售增长。

question: _____ the annual performance review, salary adjustments will be determined.
explanation: after 表示“在……之后”，指在年度绩效审查之后。

question: The customer service team is responsible ____ handling all complaints.
explanation: responsible for 表示“负责”，负责处理投诉。

question: The meeting was postponed ____ the CEO's travel schedule changed.
explanation: due to 后接名词短语，表示原因，因CEO行程变更延期。

question: All staff members must sign the confidentiality agreement ____ they start their duties.
explanation: upon 用于“在……之时”，指开工前签署保密协议。

question: The new software will be deployed ____ all testing phases are completed.
explanation: once 表示“一……就……”，测试完成后部署。

question: The marketing department has reduced expenses ____ creative campaigns.
explanation: by 用于表示手段，指通过简约创意降低费用。

question: All invoices must be ______ before the end of the fiscal year.
explanation: must be 后接过去分词构成被动语态，表示“必须被提交”。

question: Ms. Chen has been ______ the marketing department for more than five years.
explanation: 现在完成进行时 has been + 现在分词，表示动作从过去持续到现在。

question: The new policy will take effect ______ the first of next month.
explanation: 特定日期用介词 on；“on the first of next month”指具体某一天。

question: Employees are encouraged to submit their suggestions ______ the suggestion box.
explanation: “submit ... to”为固定搭配，表示“向……提交”。

question: Quarterly sales were significantly higher ______ those of the same period last year.
explanation: 比较级结构 “higher than” 用 than 引出比较对象。

question: The meeting was postponed ______ the heavy snowfall.
explanation: “due to”后接名词表达原因，意为“由于大雪”。

question: Neither the manager nor the staff members ______ available for the training session.
explanation: neither...nor 连接主语时遵循就近原则，这里 staff members 是复数，用 are。

question: The financial report ______ by the auditor last week was highly accurate.
explanation: 过去分词 prepared 作后置定语，修饰 report，含被动含义“被准备的”。

question: The client requested that the shipment ______ by Friday.
explanation: 动词 request 后的 that 从句使用虚拟语气(动词原形)，即 arrive。

question: The manufacturing process was more efficient ______ the company invested in new equipment.
explanation: when 引导时间状语从句，表示“当该公司投资新设备时”。

question: All applicants must attach a recent photo ______ the application form.
explanation: “attach ... with”表示“随……附上”，with 表伴随。

question: Our company has ______ offices in over thirty countries around the world.
explanation: “set up”意为“建立、设立”；“set up offices”指设立办事处。

question: The training program is designed to ______ employees to work independently.
explanation: “enable sb to do”为固定结构，表示“使某人能做某事”。

question: The revised schedule gives employees ______ flexibility in managing their work hours.
explanation: greater 为比较级，修饰不可数名词 flexibility，表示更大灵活性。

question: We apologize for the ______ delay in responding to your inquiry.
explanation: 形容词 unexpected 修饰名词 delay，表示“意外的延误”。

question: The manager asked that each team member ______ a weekly progress report.
explanation: ask 后的 that 从句用虚拟语气(动词原形)，故用 submit。

question: Customers can return the product ______ it is damaged or defective.
explanation: “provided that”意为“只要、假如”，引导条件状语从句。

question: The report indicated that production costs had risen ______ the past quarter.
explanation: during 表示“在……期间”，指在过去那个季度内成本上升。

question: The conference will be attended by managers from ______ branch offices worldwide.
explanation: “all of + 复数名词”表示全部，branch offices 为复数，搭配 all of。

question: Sales increased by 15 percent, ______ was more than the company had expected.
explanation: which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面的整个主句内容。

question: The employees showed ______ enthusiasm during the product launch event.
explanation: considerable 为形容词“相当大的”，修饰名词 enthusiasm。

question: Applicants are asked to ______ two references in their application.
explanation: be asked to do 不定式，故用动词原形 mention。

question: The equipment must be inspected ______ before it is used on site.
explanation: 副词 thoroughly 修饰动词 inspected，表示“彻底地检查”。

question: Fewer reports were submitted this week ______ last week because of the holiday.
explanation: 比较级 fewer ... than 为固定结构，与数量减少进行比较。

question: The new branch manager is ______ than her predecessor in handling complaints.
explanation: than 表明使用比较级 more efficient，结构为“更高效的”。

question: The company will hold a seminar next month to ______ new employees with company policies.
explanation: familiarize with 为固定动词搭配，表示“使熟悉”。

question: Despite the difficult economic conditions, the firm ______ to meet its quarterly goals.
explanation: manage to do 表示“设法做到”，此处用过去式 managed。

question: All staff are expected to ______ the dress code during business hours.
explanation: “comply with”为固定搭配，意为“遵守”；其余介词搭配错误。

question: The annual performance review is an opportunity to ______ an employee's strengths and areas for growth.
explanation: 不定式 to + 动词原形，故用 assess，表示“评估”。

question: Shipping costs have risen considerably ______ the introduction of new fuel taxes.
explanation: “because of + 名词短语”表原因；because 需接从句，due 需接 to。

question: We will begin production as soon as the components ______ from the supplier.
explanation: as soon as 时间状语从句用现在完成时或用一般现在时表将来；此处 have arrived 强调完成。

question: The customer complained that the product did not ______ the description on the website.
explanation: did not 后接动词原形 match，表示“与……相符”。

question: Please contact the front desk if you require any ______ assistance.
explanation: further 表示“更多的、进一步的”，修饰 assistance。

question: The invoice should be paid ______ within thirty days of receipt.
explanation: “in full”为固定短语，意为“全额、全部”。

question: The HR department will ______ a training workshop for all supervisors in May.
explanation: will + 动词原形构成一般将来时，故用 organize。

question: It is essential that every shipment ______ carefully inspected before dispatch.
explanation: “It is essential that”后接虚拟语气，用动词原形 be。

question: The quarterly review meeting has been scheduled ______ next Tuesday morning.
explanation: 固定搭配 "on + 具体星期几"（在某星期几）。on 用于确切的某一天。

question: All visitors must report to the reception desk ______ entering the building.
explanation: 介词 "upon + doing" 表示“一…就…”，在商务英语中常用于表示行为发生时的条件。

question: The management team is currently reviewing ______ proposal submitted by the contractor.
explanation: 特指前文提到的提案，应用定冠词 "the"。

question: Each of the participating companies ______ required to sign a nondisclosure agreement.
explanation: "Each of + 复数名词" 作主语时，谓语动词通常用单数形式 "is"。

question: By the time the manager arrived at the office, the team ______ the assignment.
explanation: 过去完成时 "had + 过去分词" 表示在过去某一动作之前已经完成的动作。

question: If the marketing campaign ______ successful, we would have seen higher sales figures.
explanation: 虚拟语气第三类，表示对过去的假设，从句用 "had been"，主句用 "would have done"。

question: The financial reports ______ by the auditors by the end of this week.
explanation: 表示将来的被动语态，用 "will be + 过去分词"。

question: We are looking for an experienced accountant ______ can handle complex international tax issues.
explanation: 先行词是人（accountant），且在从句中作主语，应用关系代词 "who"。

question: Due to unforeseen circumstances, the board decided to ______ the annual conference.
explanation: "call off" 意为“取消”，符合会议因故取消的语境。

question: The human resources director announced several ______ regarding employee benefits.
explanation: 形容词 "several" 后需接可数名词复数 "modifications"。

question: Our new line of products has proven to be extremely ______ among younger consumers.
explanation: 系动词 "proven to be" 后接形容词作表语，"popular" 意为“受欢迎的”。

question: The flight was delayed for two hours ______ severe weather conditions.
explanation: "due to" 后接名词短语表示原因，意为“由于”。

question: ______ the heavy traffic, Mr. Chen managed to arrive at the meeting on time.
explanation: "Despite" 意为“尽管”，后接名词短语，表转折。

question: The CEO emphasized the need to ______ operational costs in the upcoming fiscal year.
explanation: "reduce" 意为“减少”，符合企业控制成本的语境。

question: All employees ______ wear their identification badges at all times within the facility.
explanation: "must" 表示必须遵守的规章制度，语气强烈。

question: We appreciate ______ feedback from our customers as it helps us improve our services.
explanation: 动词 "appreciate" 后通常接动名词形式作宾语。

question: Please find ______ a copy of the revised project timeline for your review.
explanation: 固定句型 "Please find + 宾语 + 过去分词(attached)" 意为“请查收附件”。

question: The latest model is ______ efficient than its predecessor in terms of energy consumption.
explanation: 形容词比较级前用 "more" 表示程度加深。

question: The company's success depends heavily on the ______ of its sales personnel.
explanation: 介词 "on" 后需接名词，"dedication" 意为“奉献、敬业”。

question: The finance department has ______ the budget forecast twice this quarter because of unexpected exchange-rate movements.
explanation: 现在完成时 have + 过去分词，需用 revised（修订）。revision 是名词，revising 是现在分词，revise 是原形，均不符合 "has + 过去分词" 的语法结构。

question: Ms. Tanaka will be ______ the new product line during next month's regional sales conference.
explanation: will be + 现在分词构成将来进行时，表示届时正在进行或计划的动作，故用 presenting。present 作动词原形与 will be 不符，presented 为被动，presentation 是名词。

question: All conference participants must wear their name badges ______ they enter the exhibition hall.
explanation: 空格前后分别是“佩戴名牌”和“进入展厅”两个同时发生的动作，应用时间连词 when（当……时）。unless 表示条件否定，because 表原因，although 表让步，逻辑均不通。

question: ______ the training session is optional, attendance at the safety briefing tomorrow is required for all staff.
explanation: 两个分句构成对比（培训可选 vs 安全简报必须参加），用 While（虽然，尽管）表让步最恰当。Unless 表“除非”，Because of / Despite 后接名词而非完整句子。

question: The supplier has agreed to ______ the delivery date of the raw materials by two weeks.
explanation: 不定式 to + 动词原形，此处 to 后需接动词原形，故用 advance（提前）。advancing / advanced 为分词形式，advancement 是名词，均不能在 to 后作谓语动词。

question: Neither the branch manager nor the regional director ______ approved the new overtime policy yet.
explanation: Neither...nor... 连接主语时，谓语动词与最靠近的主语（the regional director，单数）保持一致，且 yet 提示现在完成时，故用 has approved。

question: Employees who complete the online compliance course by Friday will be ______ for a bonus.
explanation: be 动词后需接形容词作表语，故用 eligible（有资格的）。eligibility 是名词，eligibly 是副词，eligible to 后应接动词原形而非介词 for。

question: The marketing team is working ______ with the design department to launch the campaign before the holiday season.
explanation: 修饰动词短语 working with 需用副词 closely（紧密地）。close 可作形容词或动词，closer 是比较级形容词，closeness 是名词，均不符合修饰动词的用法。

question: ______ the invoice was paid twice by mistake, the accounting team issued a credit note to the client.
explanation: 空格后是完整的句子（主谓结构），需用从属连词 Because 引导原因状语从句。Due to / In spite of 后接名词短语，Since of 本身不成立。

question: The new office furniture was selected ______ its durability as well as its modern appearance.
explanation: 固定搭配 select...for...（因……而选择），此处表选择的原因，用 for。be selected for 是常见商务英语搭配。

question: The executive summary should be written in a ______ manner so that busy managers can understand it quickly.
explanation: 空格位于冠词 a 与名词 manner 之间，需填形容词修饰名词，故用 concise（简明的）。concisely 是副词，concision 是名词，concise of 搭配错误。

question: Mr. O'Brien will ______ the quarterly results at the shareholders' meeting on Friday.
explanation: will 后接动词原形构成一般将来时，故用 present（陈述，介绍）。presentation 是名词，presented 是过去分词，presently 是副词，均不能跟在 will 后作谓语。

question: The company policy requires that all expense reports ______ within five business days of the trip.
explanation: require that 后的虚拟语气从句用 "(should) + 动词原形"，且 reports 是被提交，需用被动语态，故为 be submitted。are submitted 不是虚拟语气形式，submit / submitting 与被动语义不符。

question: None of the applicants for the position ______ the required certification in project management.
explanation: None of + 复数名词作主语时，正式英语中谓语动词常用单数，故用 possesses（拥有）。are possessing 不用于静态动词的进行时，have possessed 现在完成时在此语境不成立。

question: The hotel's conference package includes free Wi-Fi, audiovisual equipment, ______ refreshments throughout the day.
explanation: 三个并列项目（free Wi-Fi, audiovisual equipment, refreshments）构成并列结构，最后一项前用 and 连接。so / but 表因果、转折，or 表选择，均不符合列举逻辑。

question: The warehouse manager was surprised ______ the sharp increase in orders during the promotional period.
explanation: 固定搭配 be surprised at（对……感到惊讶）。be surprised about 也可表示惊讶，但 at 是最常见的标准搭配，for / on / about of 均不成立。

question: After the merger was announced, ______ of the two companies' employees were invited to a joint orientation session.
explanation: 空格后为 "of + 复数名词"，需用可接 of 短语的代词 all（全部）。every / each 直接修饰单数名词，不接 of + 复数（each of 后可接复数但动词用单数且此处结构为 were），much 修饰不可数名词。

question: The updated software will be installed on all company laptops ______ next Monday at the latest.
explanation: by + 时间点 表示“不迟于……之前”，与 at the latest（最迟）语义呼应。on / in / during 均不能表达“截止期限”的含义。

question: The recruitment team decided to ______ the interview process after receiving an unusually large number of applications.
explanation: 不定式 to 后需接动词原形，且语义为“延长（招聘流程）”，故用 lengthen（使变长）。length 是名词，lengthy 是形容词，lengthways 是副词，均不符合语法位置。

question: The annual report, which was ______ distributed to all shareholders last week, is now available on the company website.
explanation: 空格修饰动词 distributed，需用副词 previously（此前，先前）。previous 是形容词，preceding 是形容词/现在分词，precede 是动词原形。

question: The sales figures for the third quarter were ______ higher than those for the same period last year.
explanation: 空格修饰形容词比较级 higher，需用副词 significantly（显著地）。significant 是形容词，significance 是名词，signify 是动词，均不能修饰形容词。

question: If the courier service had not delayed the shipment, the client ______ the goods before the weekend.
explanation: if 从句用过去完成时（had not delayed）表示与过去事实相反的虚拟条件，主句应用 would have + 过去分词，故为 would have received。

question: The job posting states that applicants should have at least three years of ______ experience in customer service.
explanation: 空格位于 years of 与 experience 之间，需用形容词 relevant（相关的）修饰名词 experience。relevantly 是副词，relevance 是名词，relevant to 后接宾语而非名词。

question: The board of directors ______ the proposed acquisition at its meeting next Thursday.
explanation: next Thursday 是将来时间状语，需用一般将来时 will discuss（将讨论）。discusses 是一般现在时，discussed 和 has discussed 均为过去时态，与将来时间不符。

question: The logistics team confirmed that the shipment ______ at the port warehouse until the customs inspection is completed.
explanation: until 从句用一般现在时 is completed 表将来，主句需用将来时，且 shipment 是被“扣留、存放”，需被动语态，故用 will be held（将被存放）。

question: All orders placed during the sale ______ processed within twenty-four hours of being confirmed.
explanation: 主语 All orders 为复数，且句子为一般现在时陈述客观安排，故用 are processed（被动语态）。is / was / has been 均与复数主语不一致。

question: The consultant's preliminary findings were based ______ a survey of more than two thousand customers.
explanation: 固定搭配 be based on（基于……），是商务英语中高频搭配。with / from / about 均不能与 based 构成正确搭配。

question: ______ the demand for its products has fallen, the manufacturer has decided to reduce production for the next quarter.
explanation: 空格后是完整句子，需用从属连词 As（由于）引导原因状语从句。For 作连词表原因时语气正式且位置较后，Despite / In addition to 后接名词短语而非句子。

question: The legal team is examining the contract to ensure that no clause ______ the company's liability in case of a breach.
explanation: that 引导定语从句修饰 clause，从句缺谓语动词，主语 no clause 为单数，故用一般现在时 limits（限制）。limiting / to limit 为非谓语，limited 为过去分词，均不能作从句谓语。

question: The new employee handbook is intended to help staff ______ the company's internal procedures.
explanation: 固定结构 help + 宾语 + 动词原形（help sb. do sth.），故用 understand（理解）。understanding 是现在分词，understood 是过去分词，to understanding 搭配错误。

question: Ms. Kim is one of the most ______ sales representatives in the Asia-Pacific region, having won the award three times.
explanation: most + 形容词构成最高级，修饰 sales representatives，需用过去分词形容词 accomplished（有成就的、出色的）。accomplishing 是现在分词，accomplish 是动词原形，accomplishment 是名词。

question: The payment must be made in full ______ the invoice is issued, unless a credit arrangement has been approved in advance.
explanation: once（一……就……/当……时）引导时间状语从句，表示付款必须在发票开出时完成。however / therefore 是副词，although 表让步，语义不符。

question: The board unanimously approved the budget after ______ the finance committee's recommendations.
explanation: 介词 after 后需接动名词，故用 reviewing（审阅）。review 是原形，reviewed 是过去分词，to review 是不定式，均不能跟在介词 after 后。

question: ______ several technical problems, the pilot project was completed on schedule and within budget.
explanation: 空格后是名词短语 several technical problems，需用介词 Despite（尽管）表让步。Although / Since 后接从句，Because of 表原因，逻辑相反。

question: The travel agency confirmed that ______ flight and hotel bookings can be changed free of charge up to 48 hours before departure.
explanation: 空格修饰复数名词 bookings，需用限定词 all（所有的）。every / each 修饰单数名词，much 修饰不可数名词，均不能与复数 bookings 搭配。

question: The audit revealed that the accounting errors ______ in the previous fiscal year had gone unnoticed for several months.
explanation: errors 后接过去分词短语 made in the previous fiscal year 作后置定语，表被动（错误被犯下），故用 made。making 表主动，make / to make 均不能作后置定语。

question: The vendor has not yet responded to our inquiry, ______ we have decided to contact an alternative supplier.
explanation: 前句“供应商未回复”与后句“决定联系其他供应商”构成因果关系，且后句是结果，故用 so（因此）。because 引导原因，or 表选择，although 表让步。

question: Participants are reminded to arrive at the training venue ten minutes ______ to allow time for registration.
explanation: ten minutes early（提前十分钟）是固定表达，early 作副词修饰 arrive。earlier 是比较级需有比较对象，earliest 是最高级，early enough 语义重复（已含 ten minutes）。

question: The office manager asked each department ______ a list of equipment that needs to be replaced before the end of the year.
explanation: 固定结构 ask + 宾语 + 不定式（ask sb. to do sth.），故用 to submit（提交）。submitting 是动名词，submit 原形用于不带 to 的结构，submitted 是过去分词，均不符合。

question: ______ of the candidates interviewed for the senior position had the international experience the role requires.
explanation: 空格后为 "of + 复数名词"，且谓语 had 为过去式复数，需用代词 None（没有一个），后接 of + 复数。Not / No 不能接 of 短语，Neither of 后接两者且谓语常用单数，与 had 不符。

question: The procurement department will _______ the new vendor contracts for your approval by Friday.
explanation: 将来时表达，将来某时之前的动作，用一般现在时态或将来进行时。"will forward" 符合"by Friday"的将来时间表达。

question: Employees who have _______ more than two years of service are eligible for the enhanced retirement package.
explanation: "have + 过去分词" 构成现在完成时，"completed" 作"have"的宾语动词补语，是正确的被动含义表达方式。

question: As the project manager, Ms. Chen is directly _______ the quarterly budget allocation across all departments.
explanation: 固定搭配 "responsible for + 名词/动名词"，表示对某事负责。"responsible to" 意为向某人负责，适用于不同语境。

question: The finance team _______ a comprehensive analysis of the company's cash flow trends next month.
explanation: "next month" 是明确的将来时间表达，句子表达将来计划中的确定动作，用"will conduct"。

question: Our subsidiary companies _______ required to submit their annual reports to the parent organization no later than March 31st.
explanation: "subsidiary companies" 为复数主语，谓语动词用复数形式 "are required"。被动语态用 "be + 过去分词"。

question: If the market conditions _______ more favorable, we would consider expanding our operations overseas.
explanation: 与过去相反的条件句（第二类虚拟）从句，使用 "were"（适用于所有人称），主句用 "would" 表示假定。

question: The client _______ the proposal and asked several detailed questions about the implementation timeline.
explanation: 两个过去发生的动作顺序："reviewed" 先于"asked"。但两者均为过去的已完成动作，用一般过去时。

question: Please ensure that all confidential documents are properly _______ before they are discarded.
explanation: "ensure that" 引导名词从句，"documents" 应被动处理，用 "destroyed"（被动语态）。

question: Neither the sales representatives nor the branch manager _______ available to take your call at this moment.
explanation: "Neither...nor..." 结构中，谓语动词数目由靠近它的主语决定。"manager" 为单数，故用 "is"。

question: The IT department has _______ to resolve the server outage issue that began last night.
explanation: "responded to" 是固定短语，表示对问题做出反应/回应。"applied to" 表示申请，"attended to" 表示处理。

question: The marketing director emphasized that effective _______ campaigns require thorough market research before launch.
explanation: "effective" 后的名词作表语时用名词形式 "advertising"（广告）。"campaigns" 也需要名词作宾语。

question: We regret to inform you that your application has been _______ pending the completion of your background verification.
explanation: "placed on hold" / "placed...pending" 表示暂时搁置。"postponed" 可作为"延迟"的同义词填入，但 "placed...pending" 更专业。

question: By the time the new regulations take effect, all departments _______ their compliance procedures accordingly.
explanation: "by the time" 引导的从句表达将来完成时的概念，表示在某个将来时间点之前完成。用 "will have updated"。

question: The conference coordinator _______ the keynote speaker's presentation was accidentally deleted from the schedule.
explanation: "coordinator" 是人，"whose" 表示所属关系（"...的 presentation"）。"who" 作主语，"that" 作宾语，不适用。

question: To remain _______ in today's competitive marketplace, companies must continuously innovate and adapt.
explanation: "remain" 后接形容词作表语。"competitive" 意为 "有竞争力的"，"competitiveness" 为名词，不适合作表语。

question: The insurance premium will increase by 15% _______ the recent claims activity reported by policyholders.
explanation: "as a result of + 名词短语" 表示结果/原因，比 "due to" 更正式。"owing from" 不是标准表达。

question: All team members are expected to _______ the quarterly presentation files to the shared drive before the end of business Friday.
explanation: "be expected to do" 是固定语义搭配，其中 "to do" 应为动词原形 "upload"。"uploaded" 为过去分词，"uploading" 为动名词。

question: The sales figures for Q3 suggest that the new strategy is _______ effective than initially projected.
explanation: "effective" 为形容词比较级 "more effective"。"much" 可用于修饰比较级，但放在此处不完整。"most" 为最高级，不适用。

question: The vendor has agreed to _______ the software license agreement once the payment has been processed.
explanation: "execute an agreement" 是商业合同领域的固定用语，表示正式签署合同。"implement" 指执行/实施，"perform" 通常用于工作/任务。

question: _______ the rapid advancement of technology, our company must invest more in employee training programs.
explanation: "Given" 表示 "鉴于/考虑到"，引出原因。句意为 "由于技术的快速发展，我们的公司必须更多地投资于员工培训"，"Given" 符合此语义。

question: The procurement officer stated that the delivery _______ delayed until all customs formalities have been completed.
explanation: 从句中 "have been completed" 为将来完成时，但引导词 "that" 引导的是间接引语。主句谓语 "will be delayed" 表达将来被确定的动作。

question: Ms. Johnson, who has been with the company for over a decade, is _______ to head the new international division.
explanation: "is appointed" 为被动语态，表达已完成的任命。"appointed" 作表语，表示她被指定为新部门的负责人。

question: The annual report indicates that revenue _______ steadily over the past five years, while expenses have fluctuated significantly.
explanation: "indicates" 为现在时，引导的从句也使用相应时态。"over the past five years" 是现在完成时的信号词。

question: The employee handbook specifies that all staff members _______ the company's code of conduct annually.
explanation: "must" 表达义务/必须。"have to" 也可表达义务，但 "must" 更正式。"need" 后需接 "to"。

question: The budget committee is currently considering proposals ___________ the underperforming departments.
explanation: "considering proposals" 是 "considering + 名词"。"to reduce" 为动词不定式作 "proposals" 的定语，表达意图。

question: The hotel manager _________ a room with a view of the ocean for the VIP guest upon arrival.
explanation: "'upon arrival'" 表示过去的action之前的另一个action，用"had reserved" (过去完成时)。

question: The client will only approve the contract ___________ all terms have been thoroughly negotiated and agreed upon.
explanation: "only...after" 强调"在...之后"，表示合同只会被批准是在所有条款被谈判并同意之后。"if" 和 "before" 不符合逻辑。

question: The new hire's performance was described as___________ exceeding expectations during the first evaluation period.
explanation: "described as" 是固定搭配，接词或词组描述主语的状态/品质。"as exceeding expectations" 描述性能过高。

question: The financial analyst recommended that the investment _______ closely monitored throughout the remainder of the quarter.
explanation: "recommend that" 引导虚拟语气，从句使用 "be" (虚拟主语 "investment" 为单数)。

question: The marketing campaign received widespread attention, ___________ resulted in a significant increase in customer engagement.
explanation: "which" 引导非限制性定语从句，指代整个前句。"that" 用于限定性定语从句。

question: The company's ___________ commitment to sustainability is reflected in its recent green energy investments.
explanation: "commitment" 是不可数名词。"continual" 表示 "间断性的继续"，"continuous" 表示 "连续不断的"。形容词 "continual" 更常用于抽象名词。

question: The HR department is currently ___________ applications for the vacant position of Senior Project Manager.
explanation: "is currently" + "动名词" 构成现在进行时，描述正在进行的招聘申请审核工作。

question: To ensure seamless ___________ between the two divisions, a liaison officer has been appointed.
explanation: "seamless" 修饰不可数名词。"communication" 与 "between" 搭配，表示 "两个部门之间的沟通"。

question: Had the board ___________ the proposal, the project would have commenced earlier this year.
explanation: ‘will deliver’ 表达将来某一时点之前的动作，符合 ‘by the agreed delivery date’ 的将来时间表达。

question: The vendor ___________ the goods by the agreed delivery date or a penalty will be imposed.
explanation: 'must have + 过去分词' 表示必然发生或必需完成的动作，符合公司政策要求语境。

question: All employees ___________ their work equipment returned before departing on leave for extended periods.
explanation: "must" 表示义务，但在公司政策中常用 "shall"。"ought to" 后需接 "to"。

question: The financial statements ___________ audited annually by certified public accountants to ensure accuracy.
explanation: "financial statements" 为复数主语，被动语态 "are audited"。"by CPA" 表示执行主体。

question: The conference venue was selected ___________ convenient access to public transportation and ample parking space.
explanation: "selected for" 表示 "因...而选择"，接名词或动名词。"convenient access" 为名词短语，表达选择理由。

question: Our quarterly performance review process will conclude ___________ all feedback has been collected from supervisors.
explanation: "once" 表示 "一旦...就..."，描述一个动作在另一个动作完成后发生。"until" 表示持续到某时间。

question: The new software update includes several features ___________ enhance both productivity and data security for remote workers.
explanation: "features designed to" 是 "设计用来...的" 的被动固定用法，"designed to" 作 "features" 的定语。

question: The quarterly report _____ by the accounting department before the board meeting.
explanation: 被动语态将来时。报告是被会计部门准备的（受动作），主语是 report，需用 will be prepared。

question: Neither the manager nor the employees _____ satisfied with the new policy.
explanation: neither...nor... 就近原则：靠近动词的主语是复数 employees，谓语用复数 are。

question: Please submit your expense reports _____ Friday at the latest.
explanation: by 表示「不晚于、截止到」，符合 at the latest 的语境；until 表示持续到某时，不符合截止日期含义。

question: The CEO's decision to expand overseas _____ on thorough market research.
explanation: 决策是基于研究的（被动关系），主语 decision 与 base 为被动，需用 was based on。

question: Had the contract been signed earlier, the project _____ on schedule.
explanation: 混合条件句/过去未实现条件：if 从句用 had been signed，主句用 would have been completed（被动）。项目是被完成的。

question: The new software requires _____ training before employees can use it effectively.
explanation: requires 后接名词作宾语，extensive 是形容词修饰 training；extensively 是副词不能修饰名词。

question: Not only _____ the deadline, but the team also exceeded the quality standards.
explanation: Not only 位于句首时，主句需倒装：did they meet。后半句不倒装。

question: The marketing team proposed _____ the product launch until next quarter.
explanation: propose 后接动名词作宾语，表示建议做某事；propose to do 也可但较少用于建议语境。

question: All applicants _____ submit their resumes through the online portal.
explanation: are required to 符合被动语态结构（applicants 是被要求的主语）；must/have to 为主动语态，语气过重且结构不匹配。

question: The budget for the conference _____ approved by the finance committee yesterday.
explanation: 昨天的动作用一般过去时 was；且 budget 与 approve 为被动关系，需用 was approved。

question: _____ the heavy rain, the outdoor event proceeded as scheduled.
explanation: Despite 介词短语表示让步，后接名词短语 the heavy rain；Although 为连词需接从句。

question: The HR department is responsible _____ recruiting and training new staff.
explanation: be responsible for 是固定搭配，意为「负责」；后接动名词 recruiting/training。

question: If the shipment _____ on time, we will meet our delivery deadline.
explanation: 第一类条件句：if 从句用一般现在时表将来，主句用将来时。arrives 为第三人称单数。

question: The manager suggested that the team _____ the proposal before submitting it.
explanation: suggest that 从句用虚拟语气：should + 动词原形，should 可省略，故用 review。

question: _____ of the candidates have the required certification for this position.
explanation: None of 表示「没有一个」，用于三者以上；Neither 只用于两者。语境暗示候选人不止两个。

question: The company's profits have increased _____ 15% compared to last year.
explanation: increase by 表示增长幅度；increase to 表示增长到某数值。15% 为幅度，用 by。

question: We would appreciate _____ if you could reply by tomorrow.
explanation: appreciate it if 固定句式，it 为形式宾语，真正宾语是后面的 if 从句。

question: The new regulations require all employees _____ a confidentiality agreement.
explanation: require sb to do sth 固定结构，require 后接宾语 + 不定式。

question: _____ the project was challenging, the team completed it ahead of schedule.
explanation: Although 引导让步状语从句，表示「尽管项目有挑战性」，与后半句形成转折。

question: The client insisted that the invoice _____ immediately.
explanation: insist that 从句用虚拟语气：should + be + 过去分词（被动），should 省略，故用 be paid。

question: _____ his busy schedule, Mr. Tanaka found time to mentor junior staff.
explanation: Despite 和 In spite of 皆为介词短语表示让步，后接名词 his busy schedule，两者均正确。

question: The training program is designed _____ employees' leadership skills.
explanation: be designed to do sth 固定结构，表示「旨在做某事」；improve 为不定式。

question: No sooner _____ the meeting started than the fire alarm went off.
explanation: No sooner had...than... 固定句式，主句用过去完成时倒装，表示「一...就...」。

question: The report must _____ before the deadline tomorrow.
explanation: must be done 被动语态；report 是 submit 的承受者，需用 be submitted。

question: _____ you need further assistance, please contact the help desk.
explanation: Should you need... 倒装结构省略 if，表示「万一、如果」，比 if 更正式，常用于商务英语。

question: The company has decided _____ its workforce by 10% next year.
explanation: decide to do sth 固定搭配，决定做某事；decide doing 不用。

question: All of the equipment _____ been inspected and approved.
explanation: equipment 为不可数名词，视为单数，谓语用单数 has。

question: The more data we collect, _____ our analysis will be.
explanation: The more..., the more... 双重比较结构，表示「越...越...」；两边都要加 the。

question: It is essential that all staff _____ the safety procedures.
explanation: It is essential that 从句用虚拟语气：should + 动词原形，should 省略，故用 follow。

question: The presentation was _____ informative that everyone stayed until the end.
explanation: so + 形容词 + that 结果状语从句；such 用于 such a/an + 形容词 + 名词。informative 为形容词，用 so。

question: _____ the CEO's approval, the merger cannot proceed.
explanation: Without 介词短语作条件状语，表示「没有...就不能」；Unless 为连词需接从句。

question: The committee recommended that the proposal _____ reviewed by legal counsel.
explanation: recommend that 从句用虚拟语气：should + be + 过去分词，should 省略，故用 be reviewed。

question: _____ working overtime, the project was completed on time.
explanation: Thanks to 表示「多亏了、归功于」，含褒义；Due to/Owing to 中性；语境为正面结果，用 Thanks to。

question: The manager asked _____ the report was ready for submission.
explanation: ask if/whether 引导宾语从句，两者均可；whether 更正式，常用于商务语境。

question: Each of the participants _____ received a certificate of completion.
explanation: Each of + 复数名词，谓语用单数 has；each 作主语时视为单数。

question: The new policy will take effect _____ January 1st.
explanation: 具体日期用介词 on；take effect on 固定搭配。

question: _____ the economy improves, the company plans to hire more staff.
explanation: If 引导条件状语从句；When 表示「当...时」确信会发生；语境均可，视语气而定。

question: The director suggested _____ a new vendor for office supplies.
explanation: suggest doing sth 固定搭配，建议做某事；suggest to do 不用。

question: Not until the audit is complete _____ the financial statements be released.
explanation: Not until 位于句首时，主句倒装：can the financial statements be released（情态动词前置）。

question: The company's success is largely _____ to its innovative culture.
explanation: be due to 固定搭配，意为「归因于、由于」；attributed to 需用 be attributed to；contributed to 为主动。

question: The quarterly financial report, which was prepared by the accounting department, _____ to the board of directors next Monday.
explanation: 本题考查状语从句和时态搭配。主句为将来时，表述'下周一提交'，从句'which was prepared by the accounting department'为定语从句，描述过去的准备动作，不影响主句时态。因此主句应使用将来时 will be submitted。"is being submitted"表示进行时，不符合'下周一'的将来性；"has been submitted"为现在完成时，无法与'next Monday'搭配；"was submitted"为过去时，与'next Monday'矛盾。

question: Our marketing team has been working on the new campaign _____ two months, and we expect to launch it by the end of this quarter.
explanation: 本题考查动词'work on'与时间介词的搭配。'work on ... for two months'表示持续了两个月，是正确的搭配。'since'后面通常接具体时间点（如'since January'），而非时间段；'during'用于'期间'，不与'work on'搭配；'by'表示截止时间，意义不符。

question: If the vendor _____ the updated contract by Friday, we will proceed with the signed agreement next week.
explanation: 本题考查零条件句的时态一致性。在 If 条件句中，当条件为一般真实或可能性时，应使用一般过去时或一般现在时。这里'If the vendor delivers...'是第一条件句的常见形式（实际上是混合形式，但在商务英语中常用一般过去时）。'will deliver'不用于条件子句；'has delivered'为现在完成时，不符合假设；'would deliver'为情条件式，使句子失去及时性。

question: The project manager requested that each team member _____ a progress report before the morning meeting.
explanation: 本题考查虚拟语气(cue word 'requested that')。在'request that'后应使用虚拟语气，即动词原形。'submit'为动词原形，符合虚拟语气要求；'submits'为第三人称单数，属于陈述语气；'submitted'为过去式；'should submit'也可接受，但 'should'在此显得多余，原形更为直接。

question: The new employee_____ , the HR director recommended additional training in customer service protocols.
explanation: 本题考查分词短语结构与逻辑主语。'The HR director hired the new employee'才是完整的动作，'the new employee'是动作的承受者。'having hired'表示过去先于HR推荐动作完成的动作，并且动词的主动者是HR总监。'having been hired'表示被动含义，但逻辑主语应为员工，与'HR director recommended'中的逻辑不一致。

question: By the time the client _____ us, we will have completed the presentation slides and prepared the budget forecast.
explanation: 本题考查将来完成时的使用。'By the time...'引导的从属时间状语中，通常使用一般过去时表示将来，而主句使用过去完成时或将来完成时。这里从句'use general present tense to refer to the future'是常见用法，'calls'符合；'called'为过去式，用法不当；'will call'在时间状语从句中通常不用'will'；'has called'为现在完成时，不能与'will have completed'并列。

question: Neither the sales representatives nor the manager _____ responsible for finalizing the contract terms this afternoon.
explanation: 本题考查'verb-subject agreement with neither...nor'。当'manager'(单数)位于'nor'之后紧邻动词时，动词应与最近的主语'manager'保持一致，使用单数形式'is'。'are'错误地与'sales representatives'搭配；'have been'为现在完成时；'were being'为过去进行时，均不符合上下文。

question: The annual budget _____ by the finance committee next month, so all department heads must submit their requests by Friday.
explanation: 本题考查将来被动语态的表达方式。'The annual budget will be approved'直接表达未来被动，符合上下文('so all department heads must submit...')。'is going to be approved'也可用于将来但不如'will be'简洁；'approves'为主动现时；'is being approved'为现在进行时，均不准确。

question: The company policy states that employees _____ at least two weeks' notice before resigning from their positions.
explanation: 本题考查'states that'引导的名义性从句与虚拟语气。'The company policy states that...'后应使用陈述语气表示事实，但在正式书面语中，名义性动词如'state'常带有虚拟语气色彩，要求使用动词原形'give'。'gives'为第三人称单数，'gave'为过去式，'should give'增加了不必要的情态意义。

question: The conference room that _____ yesterday is now ready for the upcoming board meeting.
explanation: 本题考查定语从句的时态一致性。'that was painted yesterday'作为定语从句修饰'conference room'，使用过去时表示Room已经完成刷漆。'painted'为分词，可作后置定语，但放在'meeting'后面更自然；'having been painted'为过去完成被动，但在定语从句中不常见；'being painted'为现在进行时，逻辑矛盾。

question: The procurement manager sent an email confirming that all necessary documents _____ attached to the shipment by the courier service.
explanation: 本题考查间接引语中谓语动词的时态变化。在'confirming that...'后面，原文是'said that the documents are/were attached'。因为'confirming'是过去时上下文，引述内容也应回退到过去时，因此'were'正确。'are'为现在时，未发生时态回退；'have been'为现在完成时；'been'为分词形式，不完整。

question: Compared with last quarter, the company's revenue _____ significantly, which reflects the positive impact of our new marketing strategy.
explanation: 本题考查'compared with'引导的比较结构与时态选择。'Compared with last quarter'提示过去与现在的比较，'revenue has grown'为现在完成时，强调从去季到现在的增长过程及其结果，符合'which reflects...'的逻辑。'is growing'为现在进行时；'grew'为过去时；'had grown'为过去完成时，用法不当。

question: The travel expenses must be submitted _____ along with the original receipts, otherwise the reimbursement process will be delayed.
explanation: 本题考查动词/动词短语的惯用搭配。提交费用时，'submit online'是现代商务中常见的电子化操作方式，符合上下文。'in person'为直接递交的方式；'by mail'为邮寄；'in detail'为详尽地修饰'提交'，不涉及提交方式，语义不连贯。

question: The new policy applies to all full-time employees, _____ those who were hired before January 1st, 2023.
explanation: 本题考查'including'引导的插入性成分。'including those who were hired...'为正确的用法，'those'指代'exployees'。'including that of'引入比较结构，不符合；'including those'重复了'those'；'including the ones'中的'ones'用于名词后代指人或物，但在正式书面语中'those'更佳。

question: The supplier agreed _____ the contract terms, but they requested a revision to the delivery schedule.
explanation: 本题考查动词不定式目的与逻辑关系。'agreed to sign'表示同意签署，是正确的用法。'signing'为动名词，但'agree to do'比'agree doing'更常见；'having signed'为过去完成分词，表示已签署，矛盾；'signed'为过去式，无法与'agreed'并列。

question: The board members, _____ of whom have experience in international markets, voted unanimously in favor of the expansion proposal.
explanation: 本题考查'none/some/many/several of whom'引导的定语从句。'Many of whom have experience...'表示'有多人有国际市场经验'，语义通顺。'none of whom'表示'没有人'，矛盾；'some of whom'表示'有些人'，但在正式语境中不够明确；'several of whom'也可接受，但'many'更贴合'unanimously'的语境。

question: _____ between the deadline and the budget constraints, the project team decided to prioritize essential features only.
explanation: 本题考查介词短语/动词-ing形式的用法。'Considering between...'语义不正确，应为'Considering the deadline and budget constraints'。'Having considered'为过去完成分词；'To consider'为不定式，但在句首引导让步时态不一致；'In consideration of'适用于正式文献，非日常商务语。

question: _____ we understand the importance of customer feedback, we still need to analyze the data more thoroughly before making any decisions.
explanation: 本题考查让步连词的使用。'While we understand...'表示 '虽然我们理解，但...'，语义流畅，符合上下文。'Although'和'Even though'也可，但'still'已表达让步，因此重复；'Whereas'表示对比而非让步。

question: The IT department has rolled out _____ security software update to ensure all company devices are protected against the latest threats.
explanation: 本题考查冠词的使用。'rolled out a security software update'表示发布一次具体的更新，使用不定冠词'a'，符合语境。'an'用于元音发音前；'the'表示特定的；不加冠词则表示泛泛的软件更新，缺乏针对性。

question: The assistant manager, who was assigned to handle_____ , will report directly to the CEO during the restructuring period.
explanation: 本题考查名词与动名词-ing形式的区别。'assigned to handle accounting'表示主管负责整个会计工作，动名词-ing作抽象名词。'the account'为具体账目；'an account'为一个账目；'accounts'为复数，通常指客户账户。

question: The new regulations require that every employee _____ trained on the updated compliance procedures before the end of the month.
explanation: 本题考查虚拟语气在'require that'引导的名义性从句中的应用。'require that...'后应使用虚拟语气，即动词原形'be'。'is'为第三人称单数，属于陈述语气；'was'为过去式；'has been'为现在完成时，均不符合虚拟语气要求。

question: Unlike_____ , which experienced a decline in sales, our company achieved impressive growth this fiscal year.
explanation: 本题考查'Unlike'引导的对比结构。'Unlike their competitors'正确使用了复数代词'their'来指代多个竞争对手。'its competitors'中的'its'为第三人称单数所所有代词，但'unlike'后应与'Subject'一致，此处指多个公司；'the competitors'省略了所有格；'a competitor'为单数，不符合复数比较。

question: The conference coordinator arranged _____ sessions for attendees to network after the keynote speeches concluded.
explanation: 本题考查动词不定时态与ing形式。arranged for sessions = arranged to have sessions；arranged having sessions = arranged that sessions take place。'arranged having'表示安排了一个进行中的事件，符合上下文。'to have'不定式用于目的；'having had'为过去完成；'to having'语法错误。

question: The legal team advised that we sign the agreement promptly, _____ , we might lose the favorable terms that were negotiated last week.
explanation: 本题考查'otherwise'引导的 consequence 结构。'otherwise'意为'否则，否则的话'，用于表示后果，常置于句首或紧接逗号后。'otherwise so'、'otherwise then'、'otherwise and'均为非标准用法或无语义意义。

question: The quarterly review meeting scheduled for tomorrow has been postponed _____ the CEO's return from the international conference.
explanation: 本题考查时间介词'until'。'postponed until the CEO's return'表示会议延期到 CEO 回来之后，'until'表示时间的截止点。'by'表示方法或截止时间；'due to'和'because of'表示原因，不符合上下文。

question: All employees are required to_____ their identification badges visibly while on company premises during business hours.
explanation: 本题考查被动结构'required to do sth.'。'All employees are required to display...'中'display'为动词原形，符合不定式结构。'displays'为第三人称单数，适用于单数主语；'displayed'为过去式；'have displayed'为现在完成时，均不符合。

question: The client expressed interest in_____ our proposal, but they requested additional information about the implementation timeline.
explanation: 本题考查'demand/express interest in + v-ing'的固定搭配。'expressed interest in implementing'表示对执行感兴趣。'implement'为原形，与'interest in'不搭配；'being implemented'为被动进行；'to implement'为不定式，但 'express interest in doing'更为自然。

question: The annual performance reviews, _____ completed by next Friday, determine eligibility for salary increases this year.
explanation: 本题考查过去分词短语或不定时态做定语。'The annual performance reviews, to be completed...'将完成的时间点与当前结果联系起来，使用'be to do'表示'应该/必须做'。'which are to be'冗余；'being'为现在进行时；'having been'为过去完成被动，但定语应靠近修饰词，不宜拖太远。

question: We appreciate your prompt response to our inquiry; _____ , please allow us to extend our gratitude for your continued cooperation.
explanation: 本题考查连词逻辑用法。在第一个句子中致谢，第二个句子表达感激之情，但'however'(然而)更贴切，因为它引出了对比或转折——'虽然（我们感谢您的快速回应），但是（还请接受我们对您长期合作的感谢）'。'therefore'、'nevertheless'、'thus'均为因果性连词。

question: The newly elected board member has extensive experience in_____ , including roles at Fortune 500 companies where she specialized in strategic planning.
explanation: 本题考查名词短语搭配。'extensive experience in the field'表示在该领域有丰富的经验，泛指商业或金融等行业。'field work'指实地工作；'a field'为单数，不符合'extensive experience'；'fields'为复数，但通常需加'all'或'several'来修饰。

question: Should the budget committee approve additional funding, the project team _____ extra resources to enhance product quality and customer satisfaction.
explanation: 本题考查感叹句(should...)引导的条件状语从句。'Should...approve'为虚拟话体的条件表达，类似于'If the budget committee approves...'. 紧跟的句子应为情条件式，表示'如果通过资金，则团队将获得额外资源'，因此'would receive'为正确答案。

question: The training program aims to equip participants with the necessary skills_____ they can adapt to changing market demands effectively.
explanation: 本题考查目的关系词的使用。'so that they can adapt...'直接引出目的，符合上下文。'therefore'为因果连词；'however'为转折连词；'in order to'用于引导目的于动词后，而非名词从句。

question: The quarterly report must be submitted _____ Friday at the latest.
explanation: by 表示「不晚于、在……之前」，符合 deadline 语境；until 表示持续到某时，since 表示自从，for 表示持续时长。

question: Ms. Tanaka _____ the new marketing strategy at tomorrow's board meeting.
explanation: 明日董事会属于将来时，will present 表示将来动作；presents 为一般现在时（计划/时刻表），presented 为过去时，has presented 为完成时，均不符合语境。

question: The contract _____ by both parties before the project begins.
explanation: 合同是被签署的对象，需用被动语态 must be signed；must sign 为主动语态，must have signed 为完成时主动，must be signing 为进行时被动，均不符合。

question: Neither the manager nor the assistants _____ available for comment yesterday.
explanation: neither…nor… 就近原则，靠近 nor 的 assistants 为复数，谓语用 were；was 针对单数，is/are 时态不符（昨天需过去时）。

question: Please _____ your expense reports by the end of this week.
explanation: 祈使句以动词原形开头，submit 正确；submits 为第三人称单数，submitted 为过去式/分词，submitting 为动名词/分词，均不能作祈使句谓语。

question: The CEO decided to _____ the merger after reviewing the financial projections.
explanation: proceed with sth 为固定搭配，表示「继续/着手进行某事」；proceed 为不及物动词不可直接接宾语，proceed to do sth 后接动词原形，proceeding 非谓语不合语法。

question: All employees _____ attend the safety training session next Monday.
explanation: be required to do sth 为固定被动结构「被要求做某事」；require to 缺 be，required to 为分词非谓语，requiring to 语法错误。

question: The new software _____ productivity by 20 percent since its launch.
explanation: since its launch 标志现在完成时，has increased 正确；increased 为一般过去时，increases 为一般现在时，will increase 为将来时，均不配合 since。

question: _____ the budget constraints, the department managed to complete the project on time.
explanation: Despite 介词后接名词短语 the budget constraints；Although 为连词需接从句，Because 连词接从句表原因，Because of 介词但表原因与转折义相反。

question: The client asked _____ the proposal could be revised by next week.
explanation: asked whether/if 引导宾语从句，表示「是否」；that 引导同位语/定语从句不表选择，what/how 引导特指疑问从句，语境需是否疑问。

question: Each of the candidates _____ a background check before hiring.
explanation: Each of + 复数名词作主语，谓语动词用单数；must 后接动词原形 undergo；undergoes 为第三人称单数形式，cannot 跟在 must 后。

question: The marketing team _____ on the new campaign for three months now.
explanation: for three months now 标志现在完成进行时，has been working 强调持续到现在；worked 过去时，works 一般现在，is working 现在进行时无法表达「持续三个月」。

question: We would appreciate _____ if you could confirm the shipping date.
explanation: appreciate it if 固定句型，it 作形式宾语指代后面的 if 从句；that/this/you 不能作 appreciate 的形式宾语。

question: The report _____ by Friday will be included in the board package.
explanation: report 与 submit 为被动关系，用过去分词 submitted 作后置定语＝which is submitted；submitting 为主动，submit/submits 为动词非定语形式。

question: Not only _____ the costs, but it also improved efficiency.
explanation: Not only 置句首，主句倒装：did + 主语 + 动词原形；第二分句不倒装用 also。选项 B/C/D 无倒装或时态不匹配。

question: The manager suggested _____ the meeting until next week.
explanation: suggest doing sth 固定搭配，动名词作宾语；suggest that 从句用虚拟语气，但无 that 时只能接动名词。

question: _____ the new regulations take effect, all vehicles must pass emissions testing.
explanation: Once 引导时间状语从句，表示「一旦……就」；Before/Until 语义不符（法规生效前不要求），Unless 表「除非」条件不符。

question: The company's profits have risen _____ 15 percent compared to last year.
explanation: rise/increase by + 幅度 表示「上升了多少」；rise to 表示「上升到多少」，at/in 不搭配幅度。

question: Had we known about the delay, we _____ the shipment earlier.
explanation: Had we known 倒装虚拟语气（省略 if 的第三类条件句），主句用 would have done；would reschedule 为第二类，will reschedule 真实条件，rescribed 非虚拟。

question: The training session is mandatory _____ all new employees.
explanation: mandatory for sb 固定搭配，表示「对某人强制性的」；mandatory to do sth 后接动词，with/on 不搭配。

question: _____ of the applicants met the minimum qualifications for the position.
explanation: None 可指三者以上「一个也没有」，谓语单复数均可；Neither 仅指两者，Both/All 为肯定义与语境矛盾。

question: The deadline for submissions has been _____ to April 30.
explanation: has been extended 现在完成时被动语态，deadline 是延长的对象；extending 主动分词，extend/extends 非分词不能作表语。

question: We need to hire someone _____ can speak both Japanese and Mandarin.
explanation: 先行词 someone 指人，在定语从句中作主语，用 who；whom 作宾语，which 指物，whose 表所属。

question: The budget proposal _____ the committee reviews tomorrow includes a 5% increase.
explanation: 先行词 proposal 在从句中作宾语（reviews proposal），that/which 皆可，但 that 更常用于限制性从句且无逗号；what 不能作关系词，who 指人。

question: _____ the heavy traffic, the delivery arrived on schedule.
explanation: Despite 介词表让步「尽管」，后接名词短语；Because of/Due to 表原因（因交通才准时不合理），Although 连词需接从句。

question: The new policy requires that all expenses _____ approved in advance.
explanation: require that 从句用虚拟语气（强制/建议类动词），形式为 (should) be + 过去分词，be 为原形；are/were 为陈述语气，been 非谓语。

question: _____ you have any questions, please contact the help desk.
explanation: Should you have… 为虚拟语气倒装条件句（省略 if），正式书面语；If/When/Unless 不倒装，语气不够正式。

question: The software update _____ automatically at 2:00 AM tonight.
explanation: update 与 install 为被动关系，将来时被动 will be installed；will install 主动（软件自己安装自己不合理），installs 一般现在，installed 过去式。

question: It is essential that the data _____ backed up daily.
explanation: It is essential that 从句用虚拟语气，谓语用原形 be；is/was 陈述语气，been 非谓语分词。

question: The vice president _____ to the conference next month.
explanation: be scheduled to do 固定被动结构「被安排/计划做某事」；schedules/scheduled/scheduling 均为主动或非谓语，不表「被安排」。

question: _____ the positive reviews, the product launch was delayed.
explanation: Despite 表让步「尽管评价好却延期」；Because of/Thanks to 表正向原因与延期矛盾，According to 表「根据」不表转折。

question: The committee members _____ their votes by secret ballot yesterday.
explanation: cast 为不规则动词，过去式仍为 cast；casted 不存在，casting 非谓语，casts 第三人称单数现在式，yesterday 需过去时。

question: The quarterly report ______ by the accounting department before the board meeting next Monday.
explanation: 被动语态：报告是被完成的对象，用将来被动语态 will be completed。

question: Ms. Tanaka requested that all employees ______ the new security protocol by Friday.
explanation: 虚拟语气：request that 后接原形动词，follow 是原形。

question: The marketing team has been working on the campaign ______ January.
explanation: since 表示从过去某时间点持续到现在，配合现在完成时 has been working。

question: Neither the manager nor the assistants ______ available for the conference call.
explanation: 就近原则：neither...nor... 主谓一致靠近的 assistants 是复数，用 are。

question: The contract must be ______ by both parties before the project begins.
explanation: 被动语态 must be + 过去分词，signed 是 sign 的过去分词。

question: ______ the budget constraints, the department managed to complete the project on time.
explanation: Despite 介词短语表让步，后接名词短语；Although 后需接从句。

question: The new software ______ productivity by automating repetitive tasks.
explanation: 主语 software 单数，一般现在时第三人称单数用 enhances。

question: Please submit your expense reports ______ later than November 15th.
explanation: no later than 是固定搭配，意为“不迟于”。

question: The CEO announced that the company ______ a new branch in Singapore next year.
explanation: announced that 后的宾语从句，主句过去时，从句用将来时 will open 表示当时的将来。

question: All candidates ______ have at least three years of experience in project management.
explanation: must 表示强制性要求，符合招聘条件的语境。

question: The proposal was ______ detailed that the board approved it immediately.
explanation: so + 形容词 + that 结果状语从句；such 后需接名词。

question: Mr. Kim is the employee ______ presentation impressed the clients the most.
explanation: whose 引导定语从句，表示所属关系，修饰 presentation。

question: The training session has been rescheduled ______ 3:00 PM on Thursday.
explanation: rescheduled for 表示“重新安排在……时间”，for 表目的/时间点。

question: ______ the traffic was heavy, the delivery arrived on schedule.
explanation: Although 引导让步状语从句，主句用逗号分隔，表转折。

question: The finance department ______ the quarterly budget by the end of this week.
explanation: 将来完成时 will have + 过去分词，表示在将来某时刻前完成。

question: Employees are encouraged to ______ their ideas during the brainstorming session.
explanation: encouraged to 后接动词原形，share 符合结构。

question: The new policy ______ effect immediately upon approval by the director.
explanation: 主语 policy 单数，一般现在时第三人称单数 takes；take effect 生效是固定搭配。

question: Not only ______ the sales team exceed their target, but they also secured two major accounts.
explanation: Not only 位于句首，触发部分倒装，过去时用 did + 主语 + 原形动词。

question: The client requested a ______ explanation of the pricing structure.
explanation: 形容词 detailed 修饰名词 explanation；detail 是名词。

question: ______ you have any questions, please contact the help desk at extension 205.
explanation: Should 引导虚拟语气条件句，省略 if，主谓倒装，表万一/如果。

question: The warehouse ______ inventory every Friday afternoon.
explanation: 主语 warehouse 单数，一般现在时第三人称单数 counts。

question: The merger agreement ______ by legal counsel before the signing ceremony.
explanation: 将来完成时被动语态 will have been + 过去分词，表将来某时前被完成。

question: Each of the applicants ______ required to submit a portfolio.
explanation: Each of + 复数名词，主语视为单数，用 is。

question: The presentation was ______ informative ______ the entire team took notes.
explanation: so + 形容词 + that 结果状语从句固定搭配。

question: By the time the audit begins, all financial records ______ organized.
explanation: By the time + 将来完成时被动 will have been + 过去分词，表将来某时前完成。

question: The committee ______ the proposal and will announce their decision tomorrow.
explanation: 现在完成时 has reviewed 表已完成且与现在有关，committee 作单数集合名词。

question: ______ the recent market volatility, the investment portfolio performed well.
explanation: Despite 介词后接名词短语；Although 后接从句；In spite 需配合 of。

question: The human resources department ______ all new hires to complete orientation within 30 days.
explanation: 主语 department 单数，一般现在时第三人称单数 requires。

question: Had the supplier ______ the shipment on time, we would not have missed the deadline.
explanation: Had 引导虚拟语气倒装（省略 if），过去完成时 had delivered，表与过去事实相反。

question: The new regulations require that all safety equipment ______ inspected monthly.
explanation: require that 后接虚拟语气，用 be + 过去分词（被动），be 是原形动词。

question: The company plans to ______ its operations in Asia next quarter.
explanation: plans to 后接动词原形，expand（扩大）为动词。expend 为“花费”，expansion 是名词，expanding 是分词，均不符。

question: Employees are required to ______ the new security policy by Friday.
explanation: are required to 后接动词原形，comply with（遵守）为固定搭配。compliance 是名词。

question: The manager will ______ the new staff member during the orientation.
explanation: will 后接动词原形，introduce（介绍）为动词。introduction 是名词。

question: Please forward this email to all ______ on the distribution list.
explanation: recipients 指“收件人”，符合邮件分发语境。receptionist 是前台，receipts 是收据。

question: The conference room has been ______ for the entire day.
explanation: has been 后接过去分词构成被动语态，reserved（预定）正确。

question: We need to schedule a meeting to discuss the ______ proposal.
explanation: upcoming（即将发生的）作形容词修饰 proposal。

question: The project ______ more resources than initially budgeted.
explanation: 主语 project 是第三人称单数，谓语用 requires。

question: All staff members should complete the ______ training module.
explanation: mandatory（强制性的）作形容词修饰 training module。

question: The sales team has achieved a ______ increase this month.
explanation: significant（显著的）作形容词修饰 increase。

question: I would appreciate ______ about the changes to the schedule.
explanation: appreciate 后接动名词，being informed（被通知）符合被动含义。

question: The delivery will arrive ______ next Tuesday.
explanation: sometime 表示“在某个时候”，符合时间不定语境。

question: The CEO will ______ at the annual general meeting.
explanation: will 后接动词原形，deliver（发表）为动词。

question: The contract must be ______ before it can take effect.
explanation: must be 后接过去分词构成被动，signed（签署）正确。

question: Our company is looking for candidates with relevant ______.
explanation: experience 作不可数名词表示“经验”。experienced 是形容词，experiences 通常指具体经历。

question: The new software will ______ your productivity.
explanation: will 后接动词原形，improve（提高）为动词。

question: Please confirm your attendance ______ the meeting by Wednesday.
explanation: attendance for（对...的出席确认）是常见搭配，confirm attendance for the meeting。

question: The revised budget will be presented ______ the board at Thursday's meeting.
explanation: present sth to sb 为固定搭配，意为“向某人提交/展示”，故选 to。

question: All employees ______ to complete the online safety training before the end of the month.
explanation: 主语 employees 与 require 是被动关系，be required to do sth 表示“被要求做某事”，故选 are required。

question: The new warehouse is ______ than the old one, so it can store more inventory.
explanation: 句中有 than 提示用比较级，large 的比较级为 larger。

question: Ms. Park will contact the supplier ______ she receives the updated price list.
explanation: as soon as 表示“一……就……”，引导时间状语从句；although 表让步，unless 表条件，while 表同时进行，均不符合“收到价格单后立即联系”的语义。

question: Neither the manager nor her assistants ______ aware of the change in the meeting schedule.
explanation: neither...nor... 连接两个主语时，谓语动词遵循就近原则，与离它最近的 assistants 一致，故用复数 were。

question: Please return the signed contract to ______ as soon as possible.
explanation: 介词 to 后应接宾格代词，us 是 we 的宾格形式。

question: The courier service guarantees that packages ______ within two business days.
explanation: packages 与 deliver 为被动关系，且表示将来的动作，故用将来时被动语态 will be delivered。

question: ______ the delay in the shipment, the client decided to extend the deadline.
explanation: due to 后接名词短语表原因；because 后须接从句，despite 与 in spite of 表让步关系，故用 Due to。

question: The accounting department will issue the invoices after the orders ______ confirmed.
explanation: after 引导的时间状语从句中用现在完成时表示“订单已经确认”，且 orders 与 confirm 为被动关系，故选 have been。

question: Of the three proposals, the second one seems ______ suitable for our current needs.
explanation: of the three proposals 表明在三者范围内比较，应用最高级 most。

question: The candidate we interviewed yesterday has ______ experience in customer service.
explanation: experience 为不可数名词，应用 much 修饰；few 与 a few 只能修饰可数名词，故选 much。

question: Every member of the sales team ______ responsible for updating the weekly report.
explanation: every 修饰的主语为单数概念，谓语动词用第三人称单数，故选 is。

question: The training session has been postponed ______ Friday because the instructor is unavailable.
explanation: postpone...until... 表示“把……推迟到……”，为固定搭配。

question: ______ the contract carefully before you sign it.
explanation: 本句为祈使句，应以动词原形开头，故选 Review。

question: Sales increased by 12 percent last quarter, ______ was higher than analysts had predicted.
explanation: which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面整句话的内容；that 不能引导非限制性定语从句，故选 which。

question: The receptionist asked the visitor ______ the appointment had been made.
explanation: asked 后接间接疑问句，用 if 引导表示“是否”，故选 if。

question: We regret to inform you that the position has been ______ to an internal candidate.
explanation: position 与 offer 为被动关系，has been offered 表示“该职位已被提供给……”，故选 offered。

question: The company's profit this year is expected to be ______ last year's.
explanation: 倍数表达结构为 twice as much as，表示“是……的两倍”，故选 twice as much as。

question: Neither of the two proposals ______ accepted by the committee.
explanation: neither of + 复数名词作主语时，谓语动词用单数，故选 was。

question: Please make sure that all luggage tags ______ clearly before the boxes are shipped.
explanation: luggage tags 与 attach 为被动关系，make sure 后用一般现在时被动语态 are attached。

question: The marketing director suggested that the team ______ the campaign until the survey results were available.
explanation: suggest 后接 that 从句时，从句谓语用动词原形（虚拟语气），故选 delay。

question: Applicants should submit their résumés ______ the human resources office by Friday.
explanation: submit sth to sb/sth 为固定搭配，表示“向……提交”，故选 to。

question: The equipment in the conference room ______ regularly inspected by the facilities team.
explanation: equipment 为不可数名词，谓语动词用单数 is，故选 is。

question: ______ the terms of the contract, either party may terminate the agreement with thirty days' notice.
explanation: 介词 under 与 the terms of the contract 搭配，表示"根据、按照合同条款"；其余选项均不能与 terms 构成此固定搭配。

question: By the time the auditors arrive, the finance team ______ the year-end statements.
explanation: by the time 引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时，主句用将来完成时 will have + 过去分词，表示到将来某一时刻已完成的动作。

question: The list of available conference rooms, along with the catering options, ______ posted on the intranet.
explanation: 主语是单数 the list，along with the catering options 是插入语，不影响主谓一致，谓语动词用单数 is。

question: The revised delivery schedule is ______ than the original one.
explanation: 句中有 than 提示比较，需用比较级；efficient 为多音节形容词，比较级形式为 more efficient。

question: Ms. Okafor asked the suppliers to send ______ updated price lists before Friday.
explanation: 复数名词 suppliers 对应的形容词性物主代词是 their；his/its 是单数形式，them 是宾格代词，不能作定语修饰名词。

question: ______ the warehouse was short-staffed, the shipment left on time.
explanation: 前后句为转折关系（人手不足却仍按时发货），用 although 引导让步状语从句；because/since 表因果，unless 表条件。

question: The new overtime policy will ______ all employees in the logistics department.
explanation: affect 是动词，意为"影响"；effect 是名词，impacts on 结构搭配不当，affection 意为"喜爱"，词义不符。

question: All staff are required to submit their expense reports ______ Friday.
explanation: by + 时间表示"不迟于……"，用于截止期限（by Friday 意为周五前）；on/in/at 表示具体时间点，不符合 deadline 语义。

question: Ms. Lin ______ with the regional office for ten years before she transferred to headquarters.
explanation: 在过去动作 transferred 之前已持续十年的动作，用过去完成时 had worked，表示"过去的过去"。

question: The supplier assured us that the parts would be ______ within three business days.
explanation: 被动语态 be delivered 意为"被运送、交付"，符合物流语境；delayed 词义不符（延误），detained/devoted 不能与 parts 搭配。

question: Any staff member who forgets ______ access card should contact the front desk.
explanation: 先行词 any staff member 为单数，按正式语法用 his or her 指代；their 为复数，its 用于指物，they 为主格代词。

question: The project will proceed ______ the client approves the revised timeline.
explanation: once 作连词意为"一旦"，表示条件满足后项目即继续推进；although 表让步，unless 表否定条件，while 表同时进行。

question: The new scanner processes invoices ______ than the previous model.
explanation: 句中有 than 需用比较级；副词 quickly 的比较级为 more quickly，quicklier 与 more quicker 均为错误形式。

question: Please direct any questions about the audit ______ Ms. Park in accounting.
explanation: direct...to... 为固定搭配，意为"把（问题）转给/指向某人"；at/with/for 不能与 direct 构成此搭配。

question: The memo was sent to all branch managers ______ the regional directors.
explanation: as well as 意为"以及、连同"，连接并列成分；as much as 表数量，as far as 表程度或距离，as soon as 表时间。

question: The team looks forward to ______ the new software at the training session.
explanation: look forward to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词，故用 using；use/to use/used 均不符合介词后接动名词的规则。

question: The engineering department ______ responsible for updating the equipment manuals.
explanation: 集体名词 department 在句中作整体看待，谓语用单数 is；are/were/have been 均为复数形式。

question: Please ______ the signed contract to your reply message.
explanation: attach...to... 意为"把……附在……上"，符合邮件附件语境；detach 意为"拆卸"，insert/remove 与 to 搭配不符。

question: The factory will remain closed ______ further notice.
explanation: until further notice 为固定搭配，意为"直至另行通知"；during/by/since 均不能构成此固定短语。

question: Sales of the new tablet ______ steadily since its launch in March.
explanation: since its launch 表示动作从过去持续到现在，谓语用现在完成时 have risen。

question: The training coordinator will ______ the schedule once the venue is confirmed.
explanation: 情态动词 will 后接动词原形，finalize 意为"最终确定"；final 是形容词，finally 是副词，finality 是名词。

question: ______ the server outage, customer orders were processed manually.
explanation: 前后为因果关系，because of 后接名词短语 the server outage；although 表让步，instead of 表替代，in spite 后需加 of。

question: The branch in Shanghai handled ______ orders than any other branch last quarter.
explanation: 句中有 than 需用比较级，more 是 many/much 的比较级；many/much 是原级，most 是最高级。

question: All employees ______ to complete the safety training module by Friday.
explanation: be required to do 为固定结构，主语 all employees 为复数，be 动词用 are；其余选项缺 be 动词或主谓不一致。

question: The revised budget will be reviewed ______ the finance committee next week.
explanation: 被动语态 be reviewed 后接动作执行者用 by；for/with/from 与被动结构不搭配。

question: By the time the shipment arrives, our warehouse staff ______ the orders.
explanation: by the time + 一般现在时表将来，主句用将来完成时 will have done，强调动作届时已完成。

question: Each of the branch managers ______ responsible for submitting weekly sales reports.
explanation: each of + 复数名词作主语时谓语用单数 is；复数形式主谓不一致。

question: The marketing team presented the proposal to the board, and ______ asked several detailed questions.
explanation: the board 为单数集合名词，用 its members 指代其成员最贴切；their 与单数 board 不一致。

question: The new delivery service is ______ than the one we used last year.
explanation: than 提示需用比较级，efficient 为多音节形容词，比较级为 more efficient；efficienter 形式错误。

question: The meeting was postponed ______ the keynote speaker was delayed by air traffic.
explanation: 后面分句说明会议推迟的原因，用原因连词 because；so 表结果，but 表转折，or 表选择。

question: Please ______ the attached invoice to the accounting department by the end of the month.
explanation: 此处为祈使句，主语省略，谓语动词用原形 submit。

question: A lack of proper training can ______ a serious drop in productivity.
explanation: 情态动词 can 后接动词原形 cause，构成 can cause。

question: The quarterly report must be submitted ______ the regional office before the tenth of each month.
explanation: submit sth to sb/sth 为固定搭配，表示呈交给某处；at/in/on 均不搭配。

question: Neither the manager nor her assistants ______ aware of the schedule change.
explanation: neither...nor... 连接主语时谓语与最近的主语 assistants 一致，用复数 were；单数形式错误。

question: The shipment was delayed because of ______ weather conditions along the northern route.
explanation: 修饰名词 conditions 需用形容词 unfavorable；unfavorably 是副词，其余为词形错误。

question: If the client signs the contract tomorrow, we ______ the project next week.
explanation: if 条件句中主句用将来时 will begin，从句用一般现在时表将来。

question: The new employee adapts ______ quickly to changes in the workflow.
explanation: 修饰副词 quickly 需用副词 surprisingly；surprising/surprised 为形容词。

question: Of the three suppliers, the one from Osaka offers the ______ delivery schedule.
explanation: of the three 提示三者比较用最高级，flexible 的最高级为 the most flexible。

question: The vendors must sign the agreement before ______ begin supplying parts.
explanation: 在时间状语从句中作主语需用主格代词 they，代替统称的厂商。

question: Customers are encouraged to ______ their orders online to save shipping costs.
explanation: be encouraged to do sth 后用动词原形 place，表示下订单。

question: The building will be closed ______ maintenance work from June 5 to June 9.
explanation: be closed for + 目的，表示为了某工作而关闭；of/on/to 均不搭配。

question: The technicians ______ the network system when the power failed suddenly.
explanation: when 引导的分句用一般过去时，主句表示当时正在进行的动作，用过去进行时 were upgrading。

question: Please confirm the ______ of the seminar before we reserve the conference room.
explanation: 此处需要名词 date 表示日期；dating/dated 为动词形态，dates up 搭配错误。

question: The report was long, ______ it contained the detailed figures the board requested.
explanation: 前后分句构成转折关系，用转折连词 but；because/although/unless 语义不符。

question: Ms. Tanaka ______ with the company for over ten years before she received her promotion.
explanation: before 之前已发生且强调对过去某时点的完成，用过去完成时 had worked。

question: A series of workshops ______ scheduled for the regional staff each quarter.
explanation: a series of + 名词作主语时谓语用单数 is；are 主谓不一致。
