question: Customers may return any defective merchandise within 30 days of purchase for a full ______.
explanation: for a full refund 意为“全额退款”，符合语境。

question: To ensure data security, passwords must contain ______ eight characters.
explanation: at least 意为“至少”，符合密码安全要求的语境。

question: The director of human resources announced that the annual meeting ______ postponed until next month.
explanation: 主语 the annual meeting 为单数，且动作对现在有影响，用现在完成时被动语态。

question: Mr. Tanaka is responsible ______ overseeing the expansion of our overseas branches.
explanation: be responsible for 为固定搭配，意为“负责……”。

question: The company has experienced ______ growth in online sales over the past two quarters.
explanation: 修饰名词 growth 需用形容词 significant。

question: Please review the attached document and provide your feedback ______ the end of the week.
explanation: by 表示“在……之前（某个时间点）”，常与截止时间连用。

question: We are seeking a candidate ______ has at least five years of project management experience.
explanation: 先行词为人 candidate，且在从句中作主语，用关系代词 who。

question: The administrative assistant organized the files ______ to ensure easy retrieval.
explanation: 修饰动词 organized 需用副词 efficiently。

question: Delegates attending the symposium are requested to wear ______ identification badges at all times.
explanation: 修饰名词 identification badges 需用形容词性物主代词 their。

question: Building maintenance will be conducted this weekend; ______, the office building will be closed on Saturday.
explanation: 前后句为因果关系，前面是原因，后面是结果，用 therefore。

question: Registration for the leadership seminar is open to ______ employees interested in career advancement.
explanation: employees 为可数名词复数，all 可修饰复数名词表“所有”。

question: The consulting firm submitted its preliminary findings ______ the executive committee yesterday.
explanation: submit sth. to sb. 为固定搭配，意为“向某人提交某物”。

question: Ms. Lopez spoke ______ during the conference call about the new budget allocation.
explanation: 修饰动词 spoke 需用副词 persuasively。

question: Factory workers must wear safety goggles ______ the machinery is operating.
explanation: 引导时间状语从句意为“无论何时，每当”，应用 whenever。

question: The manager praised the team for their ______ efforts in completing the project ahead of schedule.
explanation: 修饰名词 efforts 需用形容词 dedicated（尽职的、奉献的）。

question: Clients can access their account details securely ______ logging into our online portal.
explanation: by doing sth. 表示“通过……方式”，符合语境。

question: The updated software license agreement will take ______ on the first of next month.
explanation: take effect 为固定搭配，意为“生效”。

question: Mr. Evans decided to postpone his business trip ______ adverse weather conditions.
explanation: because of 后接名词短语表原因，意为“因为”。

question: The human resources department announced that ______ new employee must complete orientation.
explanation: new employee 为单数可数名词，each 可修饰单数名词表“每个”。

question: Please ensure that all office equipment is turned off ______ leaving the building.
explanation: 表时间先后，离开大楼前关闭设备，用 before。

question: The marketing campaign generated an ______ number of inquiries from potential clients.
explanation: 修饰名词 number 需用形容词 unprecedented（空前的）。

question: To improve customer satisfaction, the store manager handles all complaints ______.
explanation: 修饰动词 handles 需用副词 promptly。

question: The company’s chief executive officer will speak at the international trade conference ______.
explanation: will speak 为将来时，时间状语用 tomorrow。

question: Ms. Chen was promoted to senior accountant ______ her exceptional performance and leadership.
explanation: in recognition of 意为“表彰，鉴于”，符合晋升原因的语境。

question: The research team presented ______ findings at the annual science and technology symposium.
explanation: 修饰名词 findings 需用形容词性物主代词 their。

question: Interested applicants should submit their resumes ______ email no later than Friday.
explanation: by email 为固定搭配，意为“通过电子邮件”。

question: The venue for the annual gala dinner has been changed to a ______ spacious location.
explanation: 修饰比较级 spacious 需用 more，表示“更大一些”。

question: All visitors must sign in at the security desk ______ entering the manufacturing facility.
explanation: upon 相当于 as soon as 或 on doing，意为“一……就……”。

question: The maintenance crew inspected the ventilation system ______ to prevent unexpected failures.
explanation: 修饰动词 inspected 需用副词 thoroughly。

question: Mr. Patel expects that the new office building ______ completed by the end of next year.
explanation: 由 by the end of next year 可知用将来时被动语态 will be completed。

question: The chief financial officer advised the board to invest ______ in renewable energy sectors.
explanation: 修饰动词 invest 需用副词 wisely。

question: The quarterly report has been delayed ______ the server outage.
explanation: due to 表原因，后接名词短语，表示“由于”之意。

question: Neither the manager nor the employees _____ ready for the video conference yet.
explanation: “Neither...nor...”与最近的名词(manager)一致，用is。

question: We need to reschedule the meeting; please let me know your _____ next week.
explanation: availability 为可名词化名词，意为“空闲时间”，符合语境。

question: The client asked _____ we could extend the deadline by two weeks.
explanation: asked if 引导间接疑问句，表达“询问是否”。

question: All participants must submit their feedback _____ Friday at 5 p.m.
explanation: by 表截止时间“不迟于”，符合语境。

question: Sales have increased _____ 20 % compared to last quarter.
explanation: increase by 20% 为固定表达，表示增长幅度。

question: By the time the new policy _____ into effect, most departments will have adapted.
explanation: “by the time...”引导的从句用一般现在表示将来。

question: The proposal, along with several _____ recommendations, was discussed at length.
explanation: alternative 为可作定语的形容词，修饰 recommendations。

question: Had we known about the traffic, we _____ earlier.
explanation: “Had we known”为倒装的虚拟条件，对应“would have arrived”。

question: The budget allocated to marketing this year is _____ that of last year.
explanation: budget 为不可数名词，搭配 as much as 比较。

question: The package _____ to the warehouse this morning but was signed for by the wrong person.
explanation: was delivered 为一般过去时，符合整个句子时态。

question: This is the office _____ manager resigned last month.
explanation: where 引导地点关系从句，指“...的办公室”。

question: We greatly appreciate _____ assistance you provided during the audit.
explanation: assistance 为具体的“帮助”，加 the 定冠词。

question: More training opportunities _____ by the HR department next quarter.
explanation: opportunities 为复数，将来被动将用 will be offered。

question: The new hire must _____ the safety protocols before starting work.
explanation: familiarize 作动词含有使役动词须+不定式结构。

question: _____ of the two candidates _____ been selected for the position.
explanation: Either（单数）搭配 has，与“either...or”结构一致。

question: The invoice that you sent _____ differ from the one in our system.
explanation: appear 为一般现在时，描绘目前状态。

question: The team leader suggested _____ discussion _____ after the lunch break.
explanation: suggest that...be postponed 为虚拟建议结构。

question: Our supplier is regarded _____ in the industry.
explanation: be regarded as 为固定搭配。

question: Had the board approved the merger, the company _____ to expand internationally.
explanation: 虚拟条件倒装，对应 would have been ready。

question: This model is no longer in production, so it may not be _____ when needed.
explanation: available 为可及形容词，修饰 it 复合代词。

question: The consultant _____ the client on how to reduce overhead costs.
explanation: advised 为一般过去时，匹配整个句子。

question: The deadline _____ if you submit the required documents tomorrow.
explanation: 条件句用将来时，表示“如果...将...”。

question: Not until 2023 _____ the company achieved its sustainability goals.
explanation: “Not until...”引起的句子使用部分倒装。

question: Each of the new employees _____ completed the onboarding process.
explanation: Each 为单数，搭配 has 完成。

question: The presentation that _____ yesterday _____ well received.
explanation: that 是指 presentation（单数），对应 was given...was。

question: We expect more employees _____ by the end of the year.
explanation: expect to have been hired 表达期望在年底已完成雇佣。

question: _____ the quarterly targets if the trend continues?
explanation: Will we likely meet 为将来疑问式建议结构。

question: The revised contract was signed by all parties, _____ it now awaits final approval.
explanation: and 连接两个并列句，承接合乎逻辑。

question: It is essential _____ punctuality in our daily operations.
explanation: It is essential to do sth 为固定结构。

question: The marketing team _____ different strategies depending on the campaign goals.
explanation: adapts 为一般现在时，描绘惯常行为。

question: The software upgrade will take effect immediately _____ installation.
explanation: upon 表示“在…之时”，固定用法。

question: There are too many applicants _____ position for us to review individually.
explanation: to position 构成 to 不定式结构，“应聘该职位”。

question: The finance director, _____ department has won several awards, will speak at the summit.
explanation: whose 引导定语从句，修饰“部门”。

question: More emphasis _____ on employee development than on profit.
explanation: is laid 被动语态，“放在…上”。

question: I would have attended the seminar _____ not for the urgent client call.
explanation: but for 表示“倘若……就不……”，虚拟条件。

question: The CEO stated that _____ the company's policy would remain unchanged.
explanation: therefore 表结果/因此，承上逻辑。

question: We are looking for someone _____ can handle multiple projects simultaneously.
explanation: who 引导人定语从句。

question: The committee, composed of five members, _____ a unanimous decision yesterday.
explanation: committee 作主语，reached 为一般过去时。

question: The quarterly report has been delayed ______ the server outage.
explanation: due to 表原因，后接名词短语，表示‘由于’之意。

question: Although the deadline was tight, the team managed to finish the audit ______.
explanation: on time 准时；in time 来得及。此处表示按时完成，选 on time。

question: Since January, the company ______ three new office branches in Asia.
explanation: 自某个过去时间点起至今，使用现在完成时 has/have + 过去分词。

question: The manager, together with his assistants, ______ attending the conference next week.
explanation: 主语是 manager（单数），together with 短语不影响谓语单复数，用 is。

question: The new software works ______ than the previous version.
explanation: 比较级修饰动词 works，需用副词 more efficiently。

question: Employees ______ meet the sales target will receive a bonus.
explanation: 定语从句修饰 Employees（人），主语关系代词 who。

question: This quarter's revenue is ______ last quarter's.
explanation: as ... as 结构表示‘和……一样’，选 as high as。

question: The CEO presented the awards ______.
explanation: 主语是 CEO（女），需反身代词 herself 表示亲自。

question: When planning the budget, we must ______ unexpected expenses.
explanation: take into account 是固定搭配，意为‘考虑到’。

question: ______ have we seen such a significant drop in customer satisfaction.
explanation: 否定副词 Never 放句首需部分倒装，结构为 Never + 辅助动词 + 主语 + 动词。

question: The project continued ______ the heavy rain.
explanation: despite 表示‘尽管’，后接名词短语。

question: By the time the manager arrived, the meeting ______ already.
explanation: 过去完成时表示‘过去的过去’，由 had + 过去分词。

question: The staff ______ required to attend the training session.
explanation: staff 为集合名词，可视为复数，表示全体成员，用 are。

question: She handled the client complaint ______ and professionally.
explanation: 修饰动词 handled，需副词 efficiently。

question: Mr. Tanaka, ______ joined the company last year, has been promoted to team leader.
explanation: 非限制性定语从句，补充说明 Mr. Tanaka，用 who。

question: The new marketing strategy is ______ effective than the old one.
explanation: 比较级结构 more ... than，表示‘更……’。

question: ______ of the reports were inaccurate; we need to revise them.
explanation: Some 表示‘一些’，后接复数名词 reports。

question: We ______ receiving your feedback on the proposal.
explanation: look forward to 是固定搭配，后接动名词 receiving。

question: The IT department ______ the system upgrade next weekend.
explanation: 现在进行时表示已安排的未来动作，is performing。

question: ______ the sales forecast, demand will rise next quarter.
explanation: According to 表示‘根据’，后接名词短语。

question: Either the manager or the supervisors ______ responsible for the error.
explanation: either...or 结构，谓语与最近的主语 supervisors（复数）保持一致，用 are。

question: The success of the event depended on thorough ______.
explanation: 依赖于名词 preparation，意为‘准备’。

question: The client ______ we met yesterday is interested in a long-term contract.
explanation: 定语从句中作宾语，关系代词 whom（可省略），但选项中有 whom。

question: Please submit the form by Friday; ______, it will not be processed.
explanation: otherwise 表示‘否则’，用于警告后果。

question: By June 30, the company ______ its expansion plan.
explanation: 将来完成时表示‘将来的过去’，will have + 过去分词。

question: ______ the risks, the board approved the investment.
explanation: In spite of 表示‘尽管’，后接名词短语。

question: None of the applicants ______ the required qualifications.
explanation: none of 后接复数名词，谓语可用复数 have，表示‘没有一个……有’。

question: He spoke ______ during the presentation, ensuring everyone understood.
explanation: 修饰动词 spoke，需副词 clearly。

question: This year's turnover is not ______ as last year's.
explanation: 否定结构 not so ... as，表示‘不如……’。

question: The department head praised ______ team for their hard work.
explanation: 团队由多人组成，用他们的团队 their team。

question: She decided to ______ the position after reading the job description.
explanation: apply for 表示‘申请’某个职位。

question: At 10 a.m. yesterday, the trainer ______ the new software to the staff.
explanation: 过去进行时表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，was demonstrating。

question: ______ your inquiry, please find the attached document.
explanation: Regarding 表示‘关于’，常用于信件开头。

question: The number of employees ______ increased over the past year.
explanation: The number of 为单数主语，谓语用 has。

question: The solution was considered ______ by the committee.
explanation: 主语 solution 后系动词 was considered，需形容词作表语，effective。

question: ______ the manager was on vacation, the assistant handled all client calls.
explanation: While 表示‘……期间’，引导时间状语从句。

question: She ______ for the company for five years and now feels ready for a promotion.
explanation: 强调持续到现在的动作，现在完成进行时 has been working。

question: ______ a few minor typos, the report was well written.
explanation: Apart from 表示‘除了……之外’，后接名词短语。

question: Each of the managers ______ a copy of the revised policy.
explanation: Each of 后接复数名词，但每个视为单位，谓语单数 receives。

question: The quarterly report has been delayed ______ the server outage.
explanation: due to 表原因，后接名词短语，表示“由于”之意。

question: All employees must submit their expense reports ______ Friday afternoon.
explanation: by 表示“不迟于”，截止时间用 by。

question: The new software ______ improve team collaboration significantly.
explanation: be expected to 固定搭配，表示“预期将”。

question: Neither the manager nor the assistants ______ available for the meeting.
explanation: neither...nor 就近原则，助词 assistants 复数，用 are。

question: The contract ______ by both parties before the deadline.
explanation: contract 是被签署，需被动语态 must be signed。

question: Please ______ the attached document before the presentation.
explanation: 祈使句用动词原形 review。

question: The marketing team has ______ the new campaign strategy.
explanation: has + 过去分词构成现在完成时，用 finalized。

question: ______ the budget was tight, the project was completed on time.
explanation: Although 表让步，“尽管预算紧张，项目仍按时完成”。

question: The client requested that the proposal ______ by next Monday.
explanation: request that 从句用虚拟语气 be + 过去分词。

question: Our new supplier offers ______ competitive pricing than the previous one.
explanation: 比较级 more competitive pricing 表示“更具竞争力的定价”。

question: The CEO ______ the annual report when the power went out.
explanation: when 引导时间状语，主句用过去进行时 was reviewing。

question: The training session is mandatory ______ all new hires.
explanation: mandatory for sb. 固定搭配，“对……是强制性的”。

question: ______ the new policy takes effect next month, employees should prepare now.
explanation: As 此处作“随着、随同”，表示伴随情况。

question: The team ______ the project ahead of schedule last quarter.
explanation: last quarter 过去时间标志，用一般过去时 completed。

question: We appreciate ______ feedback on the new product design.
explanation: appreciate 后接名词/动名词，your feedback 作宾语。

question: The warehouse will be closed ______ inventory counting next week.
explanation: for 表目的，“为了盘点库存”。

question: If the shipment ______ late, we will contact the carrier immediately.
explanation: if 条件状语从句用一般现在时代将来，arrives。

question: The director suggested ______ the meeting until Thursday.
explanation: suggest doing 固定搭配，建议“延期”。

question: Each of the department heads ______ responsible for the budget review.
explanation: Each of + 复数名词，谓语用单数 is。

question: The report ______ by the analyst before the board meeting.
explanation: report 是被完成，将来时被动 will be finished。

question: Not only did the sales increase, ______ customer satisfaction improved.
explanation: Not only...but also 固定倒装结构，but also 引导后半句。

question: The new intern ______ the files alphabetically yesterday.
explanation: yesterday 过去时间，一般过去时 organized。

question: We need to ______ the budget before the fiscal year ends.
explanation: need to 不定式结构，动词原形 finalize。

question: The conference room ______ for the client presentation at 2 PM.
explanation: room 是被预订，一般现在时被动 is reserved。

question: ______ the project manager approves the plan, we can start next week.
explanation: Once 表“一旦……就”，引导时间状语从句。

question: The company has decided to ______ its overseas operations.
explanation: decide to do 固定搭配，动词原形 expand。

question: No sooner ______ the email than the phone rang.
explanation: No sooner...than 倒装，had I sent 过去完成时倒装。

question: The financial audit ______ completed by the end of this month.
explanation: 将来完成时被动 will have been completed，“将已完成”。

question: Please ensure that all data ______ accurately in the system.
explanation: ensure that 从句用被动 is entered，data 是被录入。

question: The new regulations require all vendors ______ compliance certificates.
explanation: require sb. to do 固定搭配，require all vendors to provide。

question: ______ the heavy traffic, the delivery arrived on schedule.
explanation: Despite 表让步，“尽管交通拥堵，送货仍准时到达”。

question: The software update ______ installed automatically overnight.
explanation: update 是被安装，将来时被动 will be installed，省略过去分词。

question: The manager asked ______ the report would be ready by Friday.
explanation: asked if 引导宾语从句，询问“是否”。

question: All staff members are required ______ the safety training seminar.
explanation: be required to do 固定搭配，“被要求做某事”。

question: The quarterly results were ______ better than expected.
explanation: 修饰比较级 better 用副词 considerably。

question: The supplier ______ we contacted last week has agreed to the terms.
explanation: 先行词 supplier 为物，作宾语，用 which（可省略）。

question: The team leader recommended that the project ______ reviewed immediately.
explanation: recommend that 虚拟语气，be + 过去分词 reviewed。

question: By the time the audit starts, all records ______ organized.
explanation: By the time...将来完成时被动 will have been organized。

question: The new hire demonstrated ______ leadership skills during the crisis.
explanation: demonstrated 后接名词作宾语，用形容词 exceptional 修饰 skills。

question: The quarterly report has been delayed ______ the server outage.
explanation: due to 表原因，后接名词短语，表示“由于”之意。

question: Please ______ the attendance sheet before submitting it to HR.
explanation: 祈使句用动词原形 fill out，表示“填写”。

question: The new project manager is ______ experienced in handling large teams.
explanation: 副词 very 修饰形容词 experienced，表示“非常有经验”。

question: The company ______ to expand its operations in Asia next year.
explanation: 主语为第三人称单数，一般现在时 plans to do 表计划。

question: The team remains ______ on schedule despite the recent setbacks.
explanation: ahead of schedule 固定搭配，表示“提前于计划”。

question: The manager asked us to review the proposal ______ before the board meeting.

question: They arrived ______ than we had expected, so we saved time.
explanation: 句中有 than，需用比较级 earlier。

question: The minutes will be distributed ______ the meeting ends.

question: The presentation will start ______ the CEO arrives.

question: I will send you the documents ______ I finish proofreading them.
explanation: as soon as 引导时间状语从句，表示“一……就……”。

question: The new project manager was ______ from our main competitor.

question: The quarterly report ______ to be completed by next Friday.
explanation: be expected to do 固定搭配，表示“预计要做”。

question: The server room is located ______ the third floor of the building.

question: Our office is ______ the main conference center, so it is easy to find.
explanation: next to 表示“紧邻”，位置关系最贴切。

question: Please confirm your attendance ______ this Friday.

question: Thank you for your cooperation ______ our company guidelines.
explanation: cooperation in doing sth 固定搭配，表示“在某事上的配合”。

question: The audit is scheduled to be completed ______ the end of the fiscal year.
explanation: by the end of 表示“到……结束时为止”。

question: The investment portfolio has ______ steadily since we began managing it.
explanation: has grown 为现在完成时，与 since 搭配。

question: All participants must ______ for the event at least one week in advance.
explanation: 情态动词 must 后接动词原形 register。

question: Full-time employees are entitled ______ to use the company car.
explanation: be entitled to do 固定搭配，表示“有权做某事”。

question: The venue provides ______ for all conference attendees.
explanation: provide 后接名词，accommodations 表“住宿设施”。

question: The sales team achieved ______ quarterly targets ahead of schedule.

question: The financial statement shows ______ growth compared with last quarter.

question: Customer feedback indicates a ______ level of satisfaction with our service.
explanation: 形容词 high 修饰名词 level，high level of 表“高水平的”。

question: The product launch was ______ the market research data.
explanation: be based on 固定搭配，表示“基于……”。

question: We will ______ whether to renew the contract after evaluating the results.
explanation: will 后接动词原形 decide。

question: The exhibition schedule includes ______ networking sessions for attendees.
explanation: several 修饰可数名词复数 sessions，表示“几个”。

question: The conference venue is conveniently located ______ the city center.
explanation: near 表示“靠近”，与 conveniently located 搭配自然。

question: The system requires ______ updates to function properly.
explanation: 形容词 regular 修饰名词 updates，表“定期的更新”。

question: The shipment was ______ due to unexpected customs delays.
explanation: was delayed 为被动语态，表示“被延误”。
